James J. Brasco was a basketball player.
James J. Brasco played collegiately for New York University.
James J. Brasco was selected by the Syracuse Nationals in the 1952 NBA draft.
James J. Brasco played for the Syracuse Nationals for ten games during the 1952–53 NBA season.
James J. Brasco's player rights were sold from the Syracuse Nationals to the Milwaukee Hawks.
James J. Brasco played for the Milwaukee Hawks for an additional ten games.
